text:
Your order comes to $72, which is under the $75 free-shipping threshold, so Standard shipping is **$7.95**. At 1,200 miles you're in Zone 3, where Standard takes **5-8 business days** and Express isn't available.

Because you ordered on a Tuesday, your plant ships that week (live plants ship Monday-Wednesday), and the pot ships with it. The 5-8 business days is the shipping time, so count it from when the order ships. If the transit forecast is below 35°F or above 95°F, the plant may be held up to 7 days, and we'd email you about it.
